data.long_meaning: Badmash is a Hindi name that translates to 'rebel' or 'mischievous'. It is derived from the Hindi word 'badam', which means 'rebel' or 'disobedient'. This name is often given to a child who is known for their rebellious spirit and sense of adventure. The name Badmash carries the meaning “Mischievous, Rebel” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Badmash usually hope their child will grow to embody mischievous, rebel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
